+_CLIXML_HEADER = re.compile(rb'#< CLIXML\r\n|\r\nCLIXML\r\n')
+
+
+def _replace_stderr_clixml(stderr: bytes) -> bytes:
+    """Replace complete CLIXML elements in Windows stderr, preserving other bytes."""
+    if b'CLIXML\r\n' not in stderr:
+        return stderr
+
+    output = bytearray()
+    cursor = 0
+
+    while header := _CLIXML_HEADER.search(stderr, cursor):
+        start = header.start()
+        output.extend(stderr[cursor:start])
+        body_start = header.end()
+
+        # PowerShell can emit repeated headers before the first XML element.
+        while nested_header := _CLIXML_HEADER.match(stderr, body_start):
+            body_start = nested_header.end()
+
+        if not stderr.startswith(b'<Objs ', body_start):
+            output.extend(stderr[start:body_start])
+            cursor = body_start
+            continue
+
+        end = stderr.find(b'</Objs>', body_start)
+        next_header = _CLIXML_HEADER.search(stderr, body_start)
+        if end == -1 or (next_header and next_header.start() < end):
+            # An unfinished element must not absorb a later, separate block.
+            recovery = next_header.start() if next_header else len(stderr)
+            output.extend(stderr[start:recovery])
+            cursor = recovery
+            continue
+
+        end += len(b'</Objs>')
+        # A single CLIXML sequence can contain consecutive Objs elements.
+        while stderr.startswith(b'<Objs ', end):
+            following_end = stderr.find(b'</Objs>', end)
+            if following_end == -1:
+                break
+            end = following_end + len(b'</Objs>')
+
+        block = stderr[start:end]
+        try:
+            try:
+                xml = block.decode('utf-8')
+            except UnicodeDecodeError:
+                xml = block.decode('cp437')
+            output.extend(_parse_clixml(xml.encode('utf-8')))
+        except (UnicodeError, ValueError, SyntaxError):
+            output.extend(block)
+
+        cursor = end
+
+    output.extend(stderr[cursor:])
+    return bytes(output)
